tasks.title: Implement app per APP_DESCRIPTION, one feature per commit/push
tasks.notes: Implemented per APP_DESCRIPTION: Room Task model (fractional rank, fixed time, recurrence none/daily/weekly(monthly,yearly incl. weekday mask), info, nullable parent for unlimited nesting, completion, timestamps); PriorityRank fractional/lexo insertion + background rebalance; Repository as single op entry point; RecurrenceEngine regenerates instances on completion/rollover; ReminderScheduler (exact AlarmManager alarms) + ReminderReceiver (due-now pin+notify, deadline lead, daily agenda, rollover) + DueForegroundService (persistent low-priority notification with plain-language explanation) + BootReceiver (re-arm after reboot); NotificationHub with 5 channels and 7 per-type toggles (defaults per spec); AppSettings via DataStore (toggles, theme, lead time, onboarding, agenda hour); GeminiKeyStore via EncryptedSharedPreferences (keys local-only, failover order editable); GeminiClient (gemini-flash-lite-latest, generateContent w/ function calling, key failover); TaskAgentTools (7 function schemas mirroring all task ops incl. insert-between reorder, reparent, vague-input parsing) + AgentOrchestrator (multi-turn function-calling loop, open-ended instruction system prompt, in-chat confirmations + system notification, all-keys-failed alert); UI: TaskListScreen (priority-sorted, due-now error-container highlight + DUE NOW label, drag-reorder via long-press handle, quick-add, recursive breadcrumb navigation, eye-icon info quick-peek bottom sheet), TaskEditScreen (all fields incl. weekday chips), ChatPanel (mic FAB bottom sheet, SpeechRecognizer voice-to-text, conversation history), SettingsScreen (key mgmt, per-type notification toggles, lead-time slider, exact-alarm/battery-exemption setup, theme), OnboardingScreen (plain-language permission flow). All UI under ForgeBuildTheme with MaterialTheme tokens + EngineIcons only, zero hardcoded colors. Deps justified: Room/KSP (persistence), DataStore (settings), ktor-client-okhttp (Gemini HTTPS), security-crypto (key storage), serialization (payloads), lifecycle-viewmodel-compose (screen state) — versions mirrored from sibling forgehouse50 proven on the same toolchain.

tasks.title: Data model: recurrenceEndDate (optional recurrence expiration), missed/missedAt flags, Room DB v3, rollover rules (normal carry-over / recurring no-carry-over / fixed-time->missed), Unfinished DAO queries
tasks.notes: Task.kt: +recurrenceEndDate (optional recurrence expiration, end-of-day millis, null=indefinite), +missed/+missedAt. TaskDao: active/pending-timed queries now exclude missed; +observeMissed/clearMissed/expiredFixedTime(dayStart). Room DB bumped to v3 (fallbackToDestructiveMigration kept). TaskRepository: sweepMissed() moves expired fixed-time tasks to Unfinished (dueNow unpinned, no carry-over, overdue notification), restoreMissed() returns them active as untimed, rollover() calls sweepMissed + skips recurrence generation past recurrenceEndDate (completion-spawn path also guarded). Normal tasks carry over unchanged; recurring instances keep their own schedule (no unfinished roll).

tasks.title: AI task creation FIX: correct Gemini v1beta REST payload key casing (functionDeclarations/systemInstruction/generationConfig/functionCall/functionResponse were snake_case -> function calling never engaged, so create_task never ran); add recurrence_end tool param
tasks.notes: ROOT CAUSE of AI create-task failure: Gemini v1beta REST payload used snake_case keys (system_instruction/generation_config/function_declarations/function_call/function_response) — the API expects camelCase (systemInstruction/generationConfig/functionDeclarations/functionCall/functionResponse), so tool declarations were silently ignored and function calls never parsed; create_task never ran. All keys corrected in GeminiClient/TaskAgentTools and the response parser now reads functionCall. Added recurrence_end tool param to create_task/update_task. Mandatory-duration inference already in system prompt; remaining-time validation retained.

tasks.title: Voice input FIX: replace on-device SpeechRecognizer with MediaRecorder raw-audio capture -> Gemini inline audio; keep live WhatsApp-style waveform (real mic amplitude); add distinct 'sending voice note' state
tasks.notes: ChatPanel fully rewritten: on-device SpeechRecognizer removed. MediaRecorder captures a raw AAC/M4A clip; on stop the audio is Base64-encoded and sent to Gemini as an inlineData audio/mp4 part via new AgentOrchestrator.sendAudio() with an instruction telling Gemini to transcribe/understand the audio natively. Live WhatsApp-style spectrum waveform now driven by real MediaRecorder.maxAmplitude at 80ms; distinct 'Sending voice note to Gemini' banner (primary-container, animated bars + expressive loader) shown while the clip uploads. RECORD_AUDIO permission flow retained.

tasks.notes: Creation flow fixed: removed the bare quick-add bar from TaskListScreen. New primary '+' FAB opens TaskCreationSheet (new file): title, mandatory duration (stepper + presets), optional fixed time, recurrence (+weekly day chips) with optional until-date, info, live type/color preview, parent = current level; the task is written only on 'Create task'.
